tasks.DefineVariables: Define the initial amount of money Arjun (A) and Sajal (S) have.
tasks.FormulateEquations1: Formulate equations based on the first condition where if Arun gives $30 to Sajal, Sajal will have twice the money left with Arjun.
tasks.FormulateEquations2: Formulate equations based on the second condition where if Sajal gives $10 to Arjun, Arjun will have thrice as much as is left with Sajal.
tasks.SolveSystemOfEquations: Solve the system of equations derived from both conditions to find out how much money each has.
tasks.VerifySolution: Check if the solution satisfies both given conditions.
